sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_blocks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_time" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("end_time" > "start_time"), "source" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_locked" IN (0, 1)), "recurrence" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_until" INTEGER NULL, "series_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES schedule_blocks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurrence_date" INTEGER NULL, CHECK ((series_id IS NULL) = (occurrence_date IS NULL)), CHECK (series_id IS NULL OR recurrence IS NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "schedule_block_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES schedule_blocks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subtasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "planned_sprints" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "completed_sprints" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_block_exceptions" ("series_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES schedule_blocks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurrence_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("series_id", "occurrence_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "task_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "subtask_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES subtasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "session_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "planned_duration_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "segment_started_at" INTEGER NULL, "remaining_sec_at_segment_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_paused" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "actual_duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "ended_early" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ended_early" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_provider_configs" ("provider_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_model" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_url" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("provider_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_conversations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "provider_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_messages" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "conversation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ai_conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "role" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_error" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_error" IN (0, 1)), "is_pending" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pending" IN (0, 1)), "sent_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "error_kind" INTEGER NULL, "error_status" INTEGER NULL, "stop_reason" INTEGER NULL, "turn_group_id" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "utterances" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("body") > 0), "source" INTEGER NOT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL CHECK("confidence" BETWEEN 0.0 AND 1.0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assistant_actions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("group_id") > 0), "tool_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("tool_name") > 0), "args_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "decision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "undo_json" TEXT NULL, "preview_json" TEXT NULL, "utterance_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES utterances (id) ON DELETE SET NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proposals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK("expires_at" > "created_at"), "tool_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("tool_name") > 0), "args_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "source_text" TEXT NULL, "dedupe_key" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("dedupe_key") > 0), "status" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("title") BETWEEN 1 AND 200), "fire_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "snooze_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("snooze_count" >= 0), "task_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lists" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 60), "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "list_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "list_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "body" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("body") BETWEEN 1 AND 200), "checked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("checked" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checked_at" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE INDEX tasks_schedule_block_id ON tasks (schedule_block_id)
CREATE INDEX subtasks_task_order ON subtasks (task_id, order_index)
CREATE INDEX schedule_blocks_start_time ON schedule_blocks (start_time)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schedule_blocks_series_occurrence ON schedule_blocks (series_id, occurrence_date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX focus_sessions_one_active ON focus_sessions (completed_at IS NULL) WHERE completed_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX focus_sessions_completed_at ON focus_sessions (completed_at)
CREATE INDEX ai_messages_conversation_order ON ai_messages (conversation_id, sent_at, id)
CREATE INDEX utterances_at ON utterances (at)
CREATE INDEX assistant_actions_at ON assistant_actions (at)
CREATE INDEX assistant_actions_group ON assistant_actions (group_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX proposals_open_key ON proposals (dedupe_key) WHERE status = 0
CREATE INDEX proposals_status ON proposals (status)
CREATE INDEX reminders_status_fire_at ON reminders (status, fire_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lists_name_nocase ON lists (name COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE INDEX list_items_list_position ON list_items (list_id, position)
